Māori war canoe, drawn by Sydney Parkinson on the Endeavour off New Zealand, 1769.
A Māori man and Joseph Banks exchanging a crayfish for a piece of cloth, c. 1769. Drawing made on Cook's first voyage.

People in a canoe at Botany Bay, April 1770, drawn by Tupaia — the Tahitian navigator and artist sailing with the Endeavour.

HMS Endeavour careened for repairs on the Endeavour River, 1770. Engraving after a contemporary drawing.
Kangaroo observed at the Endeavour River, 23 June 1770. Sydney Parkinson's drawing — the first European depiction of the animal.
